_readme: Exceptions for the coverage gates C6, C7 and C8.
Every entry needs a reason and the gate refuses an empty one — the point of
this file is that a gap is a sentence somebody wrote, not a silent skip.
An entry that no longer matches anything is reported as stale, so the list
cannot quietly outlive what it excused.
An exception is for something that CANNOT be tested, not for something that
has not been tested yet. A missing test is a finding and is closed with a

C8.reason: spec §5: a 500 must never be reachable. Asserting one would mean deliberately breaking the app to prove it can break. The collection asserts the opposite instead — every error case carries 'never a 500 (spec §5)', which is 40+ assertions that no path reaches it.
